Γυμναστικός Σύλλογος Μαρκοπούλου «Μαρκό»|PAE Gymnastikos Sillogos Markopoulou "Marko"|translation=Gymnastic Club of Markopoulo "Marko"}}){{Cite web|url=https://somateia.minsports.gov.gr/register-2025?club_code=%CE%99%CE%A098&federation_id=30&club_id=4881&sport_sid=25506&sport_number_comparator=equal&sport_number_value=1&application_region_id=2&application_regional_unit_id=8&per_page=500|title=Registered Associations {{!}} Electronic Registry of Sports Associations with Special Athletic Recognition|website=somateia.minsports.gov.gr|accessdate=2025-08-13|language=Greek}}{{Cite web|url=https://publicity.businessportal.gr/company/185912201000|title=GEMI Public Records - GYMNASTIKOS SYLLOGOS MARKOPOULOU MARKO PODOSFAIRIKI ANONYMI ETAIREIA|website=publicity.businessportal.gr|accessdate=2025-08-13}} is a [[Greece|Greek]] [[association football|football]] club based in [[Markopoulo Mesogeas]]. Its official founding year is 1927. Its official colors are green and white. Its [[Logo|emblem]] is a vine leaf. It uses the [[Municipal Stadium of Markopoulo|Municipal Stadium of Markopoulo Mesogeas]] as its [[Football pitch|home ground]].{{Cite web|url=https://epsana.gr/field/display_field.php?field_id=36|title=ΕΠΣΑΝΑ: Γήπεδο Μαρκόπουλου|website=epsana.gr|accessdate=2025-06-24|language=Greek}} The club currently maintains a football department, while it previously had departments in [[Athletics (sport)|athletics]], [[basketball]], [[volleyball]], [[cycling]] (founded in 2016), and [[table tennis]]. The football team belongs to the [[East Attica Football Clubs Association]] and has competed for many years in the [[Delta Ethniki|Fourth National Division]] and the [[Gamma Ethniki|Third National Division]], while in recent years it has participated in the local championship of the FCA East Attica."}}
